limits: Generated clips test whether the pipeline reacts; they do not measure real-world accuracy.
The generator's model card says its output is not physically accurate simulation; motion and speed in a generated clip are not ground truth.
Small sample: three events, three starting frames, one board, one session.
The generator ran at BF16, the only precision its model card lists as tested.
Stop zones, gates and the gate distance are hand-drawn assumptions on the starting frame.
